patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than VTEX's shape. Choose VTEX only if your buying job matches “Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify kee” rather than Sellfy's shape. Workflow advantage: Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace; VTEX leans wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce.; VTEX is Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify keeps the SaaS award..
- Company-size focus: Sellfy (micro, small-business) vs VTEX (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace vs VTEX-leaning wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Sellfy — none listed; VTEX — No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone.

Limitations — Sellfy: —; VTEX: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone; Enterprise sales and implementation cycles versus Shopify SMB speed.
